summary: Defined AgentOS ecosystem trust tiers, channels, production defaults, blocked promotions and revocation behavior.
acceptance_evidence: ecosystem-trust-policy.md defines core, verified, organization, community and local-dev trust tiers.
ecosystem-trust-policy.md defines stable, beta, edge and local channels.
Production defaults block unsigned artifacts, community artifacts and local-dev artifacts from production promotion by default.
Core artifacts require release gate coverage.
Revocation behavior blocks future activation and marks active revoked artifacts degraded.

commands.summary: Confirmed all required trust tiers, channels and revocation references are present.

blocked_shortcuts: Trust is not inferred from registry URL or local path.
Community and local-dev artifacts are not production-promotable by default.
Policy packs cannot weaken core safety invariants.
optional_dependencies: Revocation checks must work from pinned local snapshots; live network access is optional.
promotion_impact: Freezes production trust defaults before public registry, verified publisher or organization overlay work begins.
